blocks.text: Check our Miss International 2026 live updates page to get the latest news and features Katrina Anne Johnson of Philippines has ended her Miss International 2026 journey after failing to advance to the next round of the competition. The delegates who advanced to the Top 10 are Miss Indonesia, Miss Moldova, Miss United Kingdom, Miss Czech Republic, Miss Dominican Republic, Miss India, Miss Vietnam, Miss Cambodia, Miss Venezuela, and Miss US Virgin Islands.
